name: @epoch/world-experience
description: Epoch World Experience v1 (Work Order W016, experience layer): the interactive-world DOMAIN MODEL — tenant-scoped world scene/view descriptors (Experience Graph vocabulary: focused entities, visual overlays, animation instructions, narrative/status blocks, timeline/replay positions, presence, evidence references, candidate/action controls), camera/follow-agent semantics as typed data, the world-subset interaction-intent vocabulary, the pack-contributable domain visual ontology, typed fidelity projections, and renderer-envelope compilers that emit W013 mount-graph/advance-frame/submit-intent envelopes as pure data.
